In Playnite desktop: F9 → Extension settings → Libraries → provider → Authenticate. For Epic select Legendary (Epic Games). For private Steam game details, use the private-account sign-in option. Press F5 afterward to refresh.

EA/Ubisoft can show their own installation confirmations. Hold Start/Menu on a controller to enable Moonlight mouse mode; move the stick and press A to click.
ui.032: Select the emulator executable, ROM folder and user-data folder. Existing games stay in place. Supported Fritchii/Lichii history and RetroArch runtime logs are imported; other emulators track new sessions launched through Playnite.

ui.060: Shield TV/Pro: 4K output is limited to 60 Hz. A 120/144 Hz TV panel does not provide Shield 4K120. For higher refresh rates use a lower resolution actually supported by the device; optional ADB checks list its modes. Also set bitrate and HDR in Moonlight.
ui.063: Normal Moonlight streaming does not need ADB. Follow the steps below first. ADB is optional for device checks or installing Moonlight without the Play Store.
ui.065: Connect the Shield/TV and PC to the same home network. Ethernet is preferable. Open or install Moonlight Game Streaming from the Shield Play Store.
ui.067: Open the Sunshine panel on the PC and create your own administrator login on first use. Select the PC in Moonlight and enter its PIN in Sunshine's PIN page. If discovery fails, add the IPv4 address shown in computer checks manually in Moonlight.
ui.070: Match Moonlight Settings → video resolution / FPS / bitrate to the Streaming page. Enable Optimize game settings for automatic display switching. Connect USB/Bluetooth input devices to the Shield. The physical monitor should return after you end the stream.
ui.072: For ADB: Shield Settings → Device preferences → About → press Build seven times. Enable Network/USB debugging in developer options and approve the PC on the TV. You can disable debugging afterward. Android 11+ pairing-code connections are explained in the detailed guide.
ui.073: Connect with ADB and read display modes
ui.074: Install / open Moonlight on the device
ui.075: Review your choices first. Setup prepares Playnite and selected integrations, installs missing Sunshine/drivers and adds the Moonlight tiles. Existing accounts and ROMs are not copied. Complete sign-in and PIN pairing on the Connection page.
ui.079: The tool backs up your own installation's settings. The distributable contains no other user's accounts, ROMs, saves, pairing keys or display IDs. Authentication and device permission remain with the owner; the required steps are explained here.
ui.083: Restore the settings backed up by setup? Close Playnite and streaming first. Later edits are not overwritten; games and drivers are not removed. Continue?
ui.087:
PC missing: use the same LAN, a private Windows network profile and Sunshine firewall permissions; no Internet port forwarding is needed.
Black screen / monitor not restored: end the stream, then Ctrl+Alt+F11 or Restore display.
High refresh rate missing: client output, cable and Moonlight FPS must all support it.
Empty library: connect the provider in Playnite F9 and refresh with F5.
Missing old playtime: check data folder and title ID; unrecorded history cannot be invented.
Unsigned application warning: verify the release SHA-256 or build from source. You do not need to disable Windows security.
